definition.text: Heard. (1.) One of the spies sent out by Moses to search the land (Num. 13:4). He represented the tribe of Reuben. (2.) One of David’s sons (1 Chr. 14:4; 3:5, “Shimea;” 2 Sam. 5:14). (3.) A Levite under Nehemiah (11:17).

lemmas.gloss: Shammua, the name of four Israelites
Galal, the name of two Israelites
Shemajah, the name of twenty-five Israelites
